subject.title: [Bug] memory_search permanently broken for default main agent: index identity auto-vacated on every gateway restart

question: Should repair work be authorized from the reporter’s 2026.6.5 database evidence, or wait until the exact CLI-versus-Gateway identity divergence is reproduced on current main?
rationale: The destructive behavior and invalidation mechanism are credible, but the mismatching effective input is not yet known; choosing a fix before locating it risks weakening intentional index-scope invalidation.

options.title: Reproduce current main first
options.body: Run the exact minimal-main-agent index/restart/search sequence with identity inputs captured at both CLI and Gateway construction, then fix the canonicalization point that diverges.

options.title: Instrument before repair
options.body: Add narrowly scoped diagnostic output for the effective identity inputs first, then ask the reporter to rerun before selecting the behavioral change.

recommendation.title: Reproduce current main first
recommendation.body: Run the exact minimal-main-agent index/restart/search sequence with identity inputs captured at both CLI and Gateway construction, then fix the canonicalization point that diverges.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the memory index identity lifecycle introduced in their merged feature work.
